blockingFindings.title: R3 auto-check parity is untested
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires migration parity for explicit flow start, prelude, auto-check, prepare, dispatcher loop, and active flow continuation. The R3 test asserts prelude, dispatcher loop, ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH, `senti flow set init`, and `senti flow prepare`, but has no assertion for the retained auto-check behavior or wording.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion in the R3 coverage that verifies the auto-check surface/behavior remains documented after removing automatic startup confirmation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for one of its required retained migration-parity behaviors.
